name: bitquest
description: BitQuest: a top-down pixel RPG to learn JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Node.js, Python, Git, GitHub, Linux and DevOps.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run dev
